description: Barrages du Maroc is a data set listed in Africa GeoPortal (Esri), a continental ArcGIS Hub, published or maintained by Geomatic. Le Maroc est un pays semi-aride dont les ressources naturelles en eau sont inégalement réparties entre le nord et le sud. Coverage: Morocco. The portal files it under the credit Geomatic. Its tags are Barrages, Maroc, Morocco. The portal shows 2018-05-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom rights statement written on the portal listing (long text, see the linked page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support dam, reservoir and flood defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record platform-africa-geoportal-esri.
